clues: This big city stands on the shore of the Mediterranean Sea. It is the work and trade heart of its small, young land.
Snow has come to this warm shore town just once in all its years of records. That one snow fell in a sharp cold wave back in 1950.
This city was founded in 1909 as a new home zone by the sea. It grew up on the edge of a far more old port town.
One part of town is a White City of sleek, pale blocks in a famed style. It holds more Bauhaus blocks than any other place on Earth.
In 1948, the birth of a new land was first read out in this city. For a short time, the new land's state work was run from here.
